decisions.reason: As a recent handle family in the firm's core hardware range, the accumulated development, tooling and portfolio-commitment costs make management likely to continue backing it absent clear evidence of failure.

Its multifunctional concept supports the firm's announced barrier-free and system-solution direction, so management is inclined to justify the launch and give it further time rather than reverse course.
This product line sits squarely in the firm's established competence area, and after another year on the market the sunk introduction effort and portfolio logic favor retention.
The collection's dedicated public presentation and design-award recognition create the strongest visible commitment, making withdrawal within the coming year very unlikely.
